zh-CN.name: 识别优于回忆
zh-CN.description: 在当前任务位置展示可识别的选项，减少用户记住术语、路径或前一步信息的负担。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 在使用位置展示清晰标签与候选，保持导航位置和命名一致，不要求用户先记住上一页的信息才能继续。

en.name: Recognition Rather Than Recall
en.description: Expose recognizable options where needed, reducing the need to remember terms or paths.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Show clear labels and options where they are used. Keep navigation placement and naming consistent, and avoid requiring recall of information from previous screens.
